scope: Close the bounded R2013 AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b wire-structure gate by mapping the versioned ODA layout to the current section parser and handle-linked SAB record model. Do not claim SAB geometry, whole-file DXF output, or native 3D support.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.7: Printed page 70 states R2013 introduced the AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b data section.
sections.24.1: Printed page 252 defines the 56-byte file header and segment-index selectors.
sections.24.2.1-24.2.2.2: Printed pages 253-254 define the 48-byte segment header, 0x40 segment alignment, segment-index entries, and data-index rows.
sections.24.2.2.3-24.2.2.3.1: Printed pages 254-256 define 20-byte data-record headers, record boundaries, inline bytes, blob-reference records, and page references.
sections.24.2.2.5-24.2.2.6.1.1: Printed pages 256-258 define schema-index table order, schema-data segments, name tables, typed property spans, and values.
sections.24.2.2.3: For each ACIS entity the data record contains its handle and SAB bytes; the section specifies the ACIS BinaryFile prefix and version-dependent terminal marker.

authority.versionBinding: The ODA version table maps AC1027 to R2013; §7 introduces this section in the R2013 organization chapter. The field map is therefore directly versioned for AC1027.

recordModelCrosswalk.fields: The fixed header fields are read at their specified byte offsets; segment-index offset/count and schema/data/search/previous-save selectors are range checked.

recordModelCrosswalk.specification: §24.2.1 and §24.2.2.1; 48-byte segment header and 12-byte directory entries
recordModelCrosswalk.fields: Segment identity, extent, revision, alignment offsets, and segment kind are retained. Directory reads are bounded by the live segment extent and section length.
Schema index, segment index, local offset, record handle, bounded record payload, and blob-page references are retained with per-record boundaries.

recordModelCrosswalk.specification: §24.2.2.5-24.2.2.6.1.1; schema-index tables and typed schema spans
recordModelCrosswalk.implementation: src/drw_datastorage.cpp: readSchemaIndex/readSchemaData; bounded AC1027 reversed-table-role compatibility detector
recordModelCrosswalk.fields: Schema indexes, local offsets, name indexes, property flags/types/counts, and value bytes are kept in a typed section profile. The observed AC1027 alternate table-role profile is accepted only after per-segment reference, order, and alignment checks.

recordModelCrosswalk.specification: §24.2.2.3; data-record handle association to ACIS entities
recordModelCrosswalk.fields: A modeler entity is linked only to one matching handle/key record; duplicate claims, conflicting identities, missing candidates, and budget failures do not publish partial links. Raw SAB bytes remain separate from geometric interpretation.

physicalProfiles.provenanceLimit: Tracked ACadSharp sample; the repository location does not establish the drawing's original authoring product.
physicalProfiles.currentReaderObservation: AC1027, 36,736-byte AcDs section, 6 schemas, 8 data records, and three modeler entities with matching AcDs record handles. Its two schdat-segment reversed-role profile is independently retained as bounded compatibility behavior; no output or geometry claim follows.

physicalProfiles.provenanceLimit: Public dwg-verifier source; its original authoring application and production history are unknown.
physicalProfiles.observation: The 20,352-byte AcDs section has a source-bound schema/data-index map. Three same-handle modeler payloads match ODA-produced DXF group-310 bytes exactly; this corroborates record association and transport only.

sourceProbe.method: Read each existing AC1027 source, parse its AcDs section through the current reader, and compare its data-record handles with modeler entity links. This is reader corroboration, not an independent decoder.

generatedControl.coverage: The in-memory AC1027 multi-schdat profile is accepted with both schemas and unknown-property headers. An out-of-segment schema-root mutation is refused with replay disabled and compatibility unselected; reparsing the corrected same profile then succeeds. Malformed AC1032 references remain refused.

decision: Close P7-B only for the bounded AC1027 AcDs file/index/schema structure, record framing, and source-handle-to-raw-SAB association model. Keep SAB meaning, source breadth, strict selected-profile DXF output, native modeler semantics, and consumer support in their separate gates.
limitations: The source examples do not establish original authoring product provenance or broad AutoCAD producer coverage.
ODA's schema authority and the physical source receipts establish structure and payload association, not ACIS geometry correctness or topology.

P7-C remains open for version-qualified R2013+ modeler DXF shell fields and selected-profile output/readback; P7-D and P7-F remain open for ACIS semantics. Whole-file AC1027 CLI refusal remains unchanged.
No DWG/DXF fixture was copied or added to the repository; the new test source generates its section bytes in memory.
